seoTitle: Windows Event Log XML Viewer: Filter by Event ID
metaDescription: Read Windows events exported as XML and filter by event ID. Common Security events get their Microsoft title. Free, runs locally.
intro: Parses Event Viewer XML exports, lists events and summarises failed logons.
why:
Event Viewer can save events as XML. This tool reads them, so you can filter 4625 failed logons or 4688 new processes without opening Event Viewer.

Titles for the listed Security event IDs come from the Microsoft Learn pages. Other IDs show no title. Binary .evtx files are not read; export to XML first.
howTo: In Event Viewer choose Save All Events As and pick XML, or run wevtutil qe Security /f:xml.
Enter event IDs to show, if you want a subset.
Read the summary and the table.
